name: Checkbox & Radio
blurb: Checkbox and radio group, drawn from the native controls.
mechanism: Native input plus accent-color for the tint - one property, and the platform keeps drawing the checkmark, the focus ring and the keyboard behaviour.
caveats: accent-color styles the control but not its focus ring, which stays the platform's.
For an on/off control that applies immediately, use Switch rather than a checkbox - the shape is what tells a sighted user there is no save step.
